description: Uganda Water Supply Atlas District Water Summary Report FY2015-FY2016 is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Harvard Dataverse. This CSV file contains tabular data published by the Ministry of Water and Environment's Uganda Water Supply Atlas. The data includes piped water, rural versus urban access, types of water supply and the overall penetration of water by district. The data is accessed directly from the Ministry's website. Coverage: Uganda. The portal files it under the publisher Harvard Dataverse. Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences, Water, Water Access, Uganda, District. The repository dates the deposit 2017; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
